issue.title: Successor Links landing repairs: day composition, anchors, snapshots, inbox, single-pass finalize
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `plan:202610/successor_links_landing_repairs.md` (repairs 1-6), `src/native/task_complete/successors.rs`, `src/native/capture/task_complete.rs`, `src/native/capture/pomodoro_close.rs`, `src/native/capture/dependencies.rs`, cycler `080/085/086/130/135/170`

Approved landing-repair tale for the Successor Links epic (bob-cli-5w): six
audited failures block the landing.

1. Daily-note successor status/ID edits are overwritten by the separately
   staged ledger postimage (with ID, JSON claims Next but bytes stay
   Blocked); without ID, capture panics at task_blocks.rs:243.
   Repro: day file with `## Tasks - [?] #task Day job [dependsOn:: p]
   ^job`, close P, observe `[?]` remains (or remove `^job` and observe
   the panic).
2. Planned ID-less root with ID-bearing embedded subtask closes both but
   loses the inherited anchor (D recovers not_planned_today); JS adapters
   drop rootKey and normalization strips it.
3. Marker-positive invalid-UTF-8 prerequisite notes are silently omitted
   (D on p,q links after p closes and reports checked).
4. Rust inbox rule (`mac_inbox.md`) disagrees with the JS default (root
   `inbox.md`) and both disagree with nav root-plus-direct-area-child
   semantics.
5. JS Warm adapter emits ambiguous `[[d#^d]]` when prose-only `b/d.md`
   exists; Rust counts the full catalog.
6. Real finalize full-scans through legacy recovery and retirement; the
   guard test bypasses finalize to hide the scans.

Impact: the epic cannot land while closes corrupt day files, panic, link
wrongly, misreport availability, or scan the vault twice per gesture.

task_type_fields.repro: See description items 1-6; each has an isolated-vault repro

issue.creation_reason: The approved landing-repairs plan requires these six audited epic blockers fixed in one medium tale before bob-cli-5w can land.

payload.entry:
Landing repairs shipped per plan:202610/successor_links_landing_repairs.md (all six sections).

SHIPPED (bob-cli):
- src/native/task_complete/successors.rs: coherent day post-image (task edits
  composed with ledger edits; day rows relocated by block identity incl.
  minted IDs); ID-less roots retained for anchors; nav-parity inbox
  (root inbox.md + direct area children via frontmatter parent); link-status
  scan deduped per note; lone-stub net underflow fixed.
- src/native/capture/task_complete.rs + pomodoro_close.rs: staged-overlay
  availability checks; ID-less root retention; staged_overlay_map helper.
- src/native/capture/dependencies.rs: incomplete snapshots (read failures,
  marker-positive invalid UTF-8) propagate as unavailable with staged-overlay
  cover; single shared catalog/snapshot walk with done/ parity.
- src/native/vault_links.rs: unchanged behavior (timers removed).
- docs/task-dependencies.md §12.4: eligible-set wording (prose-only notes count).
- Tests: planner unit (idless root, inbox parity shared cases, stub take),
  CLI (day-file compose + mint, unavailable x2 entries, close-day compose,
  successor_integration x3: consume-net, restart/reset preserve, ref-task).

SHIPPED (bob-plugins, cycler 1.29.0 -> 1.30.0, README rows refreshed to
manifests incl. stale block-id-prompt/ledger-tools/nav rows):
- 080: rootKey preserved through normalization (self-roots dropped);
  recovery planner accepts complete open/closed sets for Warm.
- 085: vault-wide basename counts (exclusions, case rules, staged union);
  getSuccessorIsInbox (versioned nav API + safe fallbacks).
- 086: link-form comment parity.
- 130: finalize runs ONE gated plan (counts/failures propagated, gate quiet);
  cancel API Warm path with cold fallback; retirement restricted to link
  metadata + open editors with full-scan fallback.
- 135: quiet gate marker; thread rootKey-safe identities.
- 170: recursive closes carry their tree root (no cross-root guessing).
- 210: export new pure helpers. Fragments <=1000 lines; main.js regenerated.
- Tests: planner (rootKey inherit/no-guess/own-slot, inbox API, counts,
  threading), wiring (real-finalize read budget, stale-line safe failure),
  lifecycle (recursive rootKey, single-pass finalizer order), api (reopened
  attribution). 184/184 cycler suites pass; full npm 2345/2349 (2 roll-decay
  date failures reproduce on base, triaged to bob-cli-5r; 1 ranker timing
  flake, triaged to bob-cli-3w).

TIMING ACCEPTANCE (release binary, isolated full-vault copy on apollo,
6214 notes, 7 samples each, rows prove real dependent lookup; SLOWER THAN
THE EPIC TARGET, explicitly): hello 4-5ms (<=40 pass); =x no-completion
20-22ms (<=40 pass); ! real close 76-111ms (<=70 MISS); =x!1 76-107ms
(<=70 MISS). Bounded hot-path work finished in this tale: link-status scan
dedup (168ms->2ms release) and one shared catalog/snapshot walk (two walks
~55ms->one ~25ms). Residual: one vault walk ~22ms + prefiltered reads ~8ms
+ commit safety ~10-20ms + plan CPU ~30ms + machine noise. The .11 14-37ms
samples demonstrably did not cover this path; this is the first same-path
full-copy number since the 130-162ms early band (strictly better).

FOLLOW-UP PROPOSAL OUTCOMES: 5w land-triage proposals stand (ready
memory tasks bob-cli-63 decision records, bob-cli-64 glossary; +1s on
bob-cli-5t Pandoc, bob-cli-5r roll-decay, bob-cli-3w ranker, bob-cli-60
Mac comma-assist, bob-cli-5y README drift; inbox-parity/Warm-cache/latency
declined as epic acceptance). No new beads filed by this tale.

PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: record "a closed planned task hands its slot to its
successors" as a decisions strand (skipped: decisions immutable without
review; auto-decision decision_record=no).
PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: add a "Successor Link" glossary term (skipped:
auto-decision glossary_term=no).
PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP: close-tier latency residual (~85-105ms vs 70ms target
on full vault): parallelize the remaining catalog walk or revisit the
target; see timing table above.

CONTRACT POINTERS: docs/task-dependencies.md sections 11.6 (SL vectors),
12 (rule/placement/kill switch), 12.4 (eligible set), 12.5-12.6 (report);
nav 255-inbox-route.js classifyInboxNote + inboxRoute v1. Epic bob-cli-5w
left open and untouched per the repair plan (all 11 phases closed, no
parent link); original linked plan and memory records unedited.
